Class Automaton

java.lang.Object
Automaton
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutomatonMethods
public class Automaton extends Object implements AutomatonMethods
Represents a nondeterministic finite automaton with epsilon transitions.

The constructor Automaton(String) builds an automaton from a regular expression using Thompson-style construction. Supported regular expression syntax: lowercase latin letters and digits as symbols, + for union, * for Kleene star, parentheses for grouping and / for the empty word.
